## What changes for the user?

Requirement IDs and milestone:

## Validation

- [ ] `make test` (no keys or network)
- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] Folder READMEs, docs and CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] Developer STATUS.md updated
- [ ] Contract changes include docs/shared/contracts.md
- [ ] Prompt/taxonomy changes pass the eval gate
- [ ] UI changes pass `make test-ui`; light/dark screenshots included

## Notes for reviewers

Never include tokens, real documents or private eval output.
